title: Startup worktree listing dedup
intent:
#4378 / Draft PR #4401 needs your ruling on AC-3 before I ask for Ready.

Interleaved before/after measurement (isolated HOME, 244 worktrees, 0 restored windows, before and after binaries alternated so sibling CPU load hits both sides):
- first_frame: before 2,526 / 2,544 / 2,507 ms (mean 2,526, matching #3808's 2,508). After 2,203 / 1,663 / 1,956 ms dark, 1,956 ms light (mean 1,940). That is -590 ms on average and -845 ms for the best pair. AC-3 asks for at least -700 ms.
- project_state_load (the part this Issue owns): mean 1,268 -> 491 ms, about -780 ms.
- git worktree list: 3 -> 1 per startup. The reaper (456-595 ms) is off the startup path.
- 3 of the 4 after runs meet the #3808 2.0 s first_frame budget.

After the fix, the rest of first_frame is outside #4378: 420-620 ms before the runtime starts, about 70 ms workspace_restore, 380-620 ms project_state_load, and 620-840 ms browser page load.

Options:
(a) Ready #4401 after #4379 lands, and record AC-3 as met for this Issue's share, with the pre-runtime and browser-load remainder split into a follow-up Issue.
(b) Keep #4378 open against the -700 ms target and extend its scope to the pre-runtime phase.
I recommend (a): the Issue's named costs (3 listings, the sync reaper) are fully removed, and the remainder sits in phases the Issue never named. verify.run for the merged head is running now.
